guidance.PROFILE_ACTIVATION_CONFLICT: Fix the source first (retire or change the version), then mark this as resolved.
guidance.RESULT_CONFLICT: Two document results arrived. Choose the one to keep, then resolve.
guidance.OWNER_TRANSPORT_EXHAUSTED: This is retried automatically. Mark it resolved only after the owner applied the result.
guidance.DATA_CORRECTION_REQUIRED: Correct the data at its source, then mark this as resolved.

problems.TRADE_DOCUMENT_RESULT_CONFLICT: Document result conflicts with an existing output

problems.TRADE_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_INVALID: Document template configuration is not valid
problems.TRADE_OWNER_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT: Delivery to the owner module timed out

modal.resolutionHint: Choose the resolution action that matches how the underlying issue was handled.

evidence.label: Evidence
evidence.hint: Add 1 to 50 key/value pairs proving the issue was fixed. Do not include secrets, tokens, or passwords.

errors.required: Add at least one complete evidence row.
errors.duplicateKey: This evidence key is already used.
errors.keyTooLong: Evidence key must be 64 characters or fewer.
errors.valueTooLong: Evidence value must be 500 characters or fewer.
errors.maxRows: No more than 50 evidence rows are allowed.
errors.payloadTooLarge: Evidence exceeds the 8 KB size limit.
